ud1.9:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā gayāyaṃ viharati gayāsīse.
ud1.9:1.3: tena kho pana samayena sambahulā jaṭilā sītāsu hemantikāsu rattīsu antaraṭṭhake himapātasamaye gayāyaṃ ummujjanti’pi, nimujjanti’pi, ummujjanimujjampi karonti, osiñcanti’pi, aggimpi juhanti
ud1.9:2.1: addasā kho bhagavā te sambahule jaṭile sītāsu hemantikāsu rattīsu antaraṭṭhake himapātasamaye gayāyaṃ ummujjante’pi nimujjante’pi ummujjanimujjaṃ karonte’pi osiñcante’pi aggimpi juhante
ud1.9:3.1: atha kho bhagavā etamatthaṃ viditvā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi:
